Week 3 - Selling my soul to Google.#What did I add this week?
I have fleshed out some of the entities in IntelliJ, as well as added DAO’S and begun on working on getting the Goggle Calendar API integrated into the project. The latter being still under work.
I also took my time to try and understand what the whole flow of the application will become as I work throughout the weeks to come.
I also had a meeting with my clients about their exact wants for the front end so I will be ahead of that when the time comes to learn about REACT.
Which new technology did I use?
REST’ful API and getting a hold of it.
Why did I structure it this way?
It was time to flesh out the ground level of the project, to ensure I had a nice foundation to built up from and secure minimal complications ahead.
What worked well?
My clients are very open to suggestions as well as having many of their own. Getting inputs from them I would never think of myself is extremely helpful.
What was difficult or confusing?
As I stated in the start of this log, I am having minor trouble integrating the Goggle Calendar API and is still working on getting it to work.
I also thought it slightly confusing with alle the new layers to the flow to get a proper overview from back end to front end and back again.
What would I improve next time?
Setting more time off for understanding the new things I’ve learned from the week, despite my lacking energy and mental capacity.
title: Training Program Week 3

content:
Week 2 - Proper structure.#What did I add this week?
I started the project in IntelliJ and began to set up the sturctures of the entities as well as setting up the hibernate configurations.
I furthermore began to properly streamline the domain model as well as the ideas of what entities should even be in the project and how they were in relation to each other.
Which new technology did I use?
IntelliJ with java, lombok, hibernate and postgres for database.
Why did I structure it this way?
It was time to start the project up and start coding the firs tand somplest thing sthat would be the ground foundation from which the project is slowly built and stacked upon.
What worked well?
I was glad to finally have something that I did not have t ovisualize, but instead something concrete to see and touch.
What was difficult or confusing?
I feel like I am always behind, even though I am trying to always be ahead. Because there is so many new things we have learned in a short amount of time, I feel like I cannot truly go into depth with one of the things to understand it thoroughly.
What would I improve next time?
Despite not having the energy or mental capacity at the moment, I would love to dig further into everything to understand it to its bones, instead of just scraping the top layers.
title: Training Program Week 2

content:
Week 1 - setting up shop.#What did I add this week?
I set up the basic structure for the projekt in paper format. I began writing down entities and forming up the idea around the project of what I wanted it to be.
I asked my clients about what they wanted the application to have of functionalities as well as what they might have of “nice to have” functions besides the MVP (minimal viable product), depending on how much time I would have left at the end of the project.
I began making and working on a domain model over the application as well as deciding on a name for the application: Oniscidea.
Which new technology did I use?
I used good old fashioned paper to put all my ideas of the project, as well as my clients needs and ideas down into one collection. From there I could work on the ideas and form a picture of where the project should head.
Why did I structure it this way?
I prefer knowing what I go into before I start anything. As many details and set in stone things as I could make, the better.
While I need to leave some things open to be able to scope and work on it, I do prefer to get certain things down before even starting to touch any code.
What worked well?
My clients had a lot of ideas and wishes for funtionality of the application. To this working in a structured and with open communication has put me in a good starting position.
I am always tryin to think three steps ahead, so I have already instrected my clients to think ahead of what they might want from the front end as well as specific other details I might need from them in the future.
What was difficult or confusing?
Diving into new terms, code syntax and having no idea how it really works together yet is always demanding.
What would I improve next time?
I would wish I had prepared better for school start in the summer vacation. Summer vacation and getting back from it is always.
I am having problems attending enough days, so I have to compensate by doing a lot of research on my own and having been a bit unsure on some of the technical things.
title: Training Program Week 1
